description: Source code for an ARM64-specific stack walker implementation in the Google Breakpad project, including methods for retrieving caller frames using CFI, stack scanning, and frame pointers.

classes.name: StackwalkerARM64
classes.description: ARM64-specific implementation of a stack walker, providing methods to retrieve caller frames using various strategies.

classes.name: StackFrameARM64
classes.description: Represents a stack frame specific to ARM64 architecture, including context and validity flags.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context as a stack frame, including instruction pointer.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Uses CFI data to recover the caller's register states and construct the caller's stack frame.

methods.name: GetCallerByStackScan
methods.description: Attempts to find the caller frame by scanning the stack for return addresses.

methods.name: GetCallerByFramePointer
methods.description: Uses frame pointer and memory reads to determine the caller's frame.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Main method to get the caller frame, trying CFI, frame pointer, and stack scan methods in order.
